terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run python -m app.cli seed-demo && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.command: cd frontend && until curl -sf http://localhost:8000/health >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done && npm run dev
